# Bali Tide Forecast

> Bali Tide Forecast is a mobile app for iPhone, Android and Apple Watch that shows
> tide, swell, wind and surf spot conditions for Bali, Indonesia. It covers 70 surf
> spots and 29 beaches across the Bukit Peninsula, Kuta, Canggu, West Bali, East Bali,
> North Bali and Nusa Lembongan. Forecasts update every 3 hours; 5 days ahead are free
> and Pro extends this to 16 days. Free to download with optional monthly and yearly
> subscriptions. First released in 2020. Rated 4.8 from 37 ratings on the App Store.

## What the app does

- Shows an interactive tide chart for the current day: water level right now, tide
  speed, the upcoming high and low tides, and the exact time for every point in the day.
- Gives each surf spot a recommended tide window, shown alongside wave height, period,
  wave energy and wind conditions.
- Offers separate Surfing and Beach profiles, so the same ocean data is presented
  differently depending on whether you are surfing, swimming, walking the beach or
  watching the sunset.
- Presents wave and wind forecasts as charts, bars and timetables, and includes moon
  phases, moonrise, moonset, sunrise and sunset.
- Includes a map of surf spots across Bali for comparing conditions between areas.
- Provides Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for current tide, next high or low tide,
  swell, wave energy and compact tide charts.
- Has an Apple Watch app with today's tide graph, current water level, next tide, wave
  height, period, energy and wind, plus complications for watch faces.
- Can export a tide and wave forecast image to share.
- Supports metres or feet, selectable themes, a configurable preferred tide range, and
  longer-range forecasts on the paid plan.

## Coverage

- 70 surf spots and 29 beaches, grouped into 7 areas: Bukit Peninsula, Kuta, Canggu,
  West Bali, East Bali, North Bali and Nusa Lembongan.
- Named spots include Uluwatu, Padang Padang, Bingin, Impossibles, Racetracks, The Peak,
  Balangan, Dreamland, Canggu, Batu Bolong, Echo Beach, Keramas, Medewi, Balian,
  Shipwrecks and Lacerations.
- Each spot has a break type (reef, beach, point, river mouth), a skill level, a best
  season, a typical wave size range, and offshore and onshore wind directions.
- Per-spot reference pages: https://balitideforecast.app/spots/

## Forecast

- Updated every 3 hours.
- 5 days ahead free; 16 days with Pro.

## Platforms and pricing

- iPhone, Android, Apple Watch.
- Free to download.
- Optional paid subscription, billed monthly or yearly through the Apple App Store or
  Google Play. Payment is handled by Apple or Google; the developer does not process
  card details.

## Notes

- Forecasts are predictions, not guarantees. Ocean conditions can differ from any
  forecast, and users are responsible for assessing conditions before entering the water.
- Contact: balitideforecast@gmail.com
